transcript.text: Hello, this is Shreya calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking to Rahul?
Yes, this is Rahul speaking. How can I help you?
Thanks. I'm just calling about your Mumbai Bank credit card - the payment is due. By when are you planning to pay?
Before I decide, will this hurt my CIBIL score?
I'm not able to discuss credit scores. Let's get back to your payment.
I understand, but I really need to know—how many points will it affect my CIBIL score?
